BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION SP/2025)
CLASS:  BBA/IMBA   SEMESTER: II
BRANCH: BBA/IMBA   SESSION: SP/2025

SUBJECT: MN113 QUALITATIVE DATA ANALYSIS
TIME: 02 Hours   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates


   CO BL
Q.1(a) What can constitute data in qualitative research? [2] 1 2
Q.1(b) What are the purposes and advantages of qualitative data? [3] 2 2


Q.2(a) Why limitations are necessary for qualitative research? Explain. [2] 2 2
Q.2(b) What applications of qualitive data are fruitful in basic research? [3] 3 3


Q.3(a) What  is  of  more  value  to  the  corporate  world—fundamental  or  applied?  Justify  your
reasoning.
[2] 3 3
Q.3(b) Does exploratory research always lead to conclusive research? Give adequate examples
to explain your perspective.
[3] 4 3


Q.4(a) Write  a  comparison  of  basic  research  design  like  exploratory,  descriptive  and
experimental.
[2] 3 2
Q.4(b) A lot of business magazines conduct surveys, for examples the best management schools
in the country; top ten banks in the country; the best schools to study in, etc. What do
you think of these studies, would you call them research? Why /why not?
[3] 4 4


Q.5(a) What are focus group discussions (FGD)? Under what circumstances should they be used? [2] 3 3
Q.5(b) “Interviewer’s role is too critical to success of the depth interview”. Explain and also
describe the various techniques used in DI’s.
[3] 3 3
